brief.name: Your Scent, Your Expression
brief.objective: Invite discovery of personal fragrance expression without asserting tested layering results.
brief.audience: UAE fragrance enthusiasts curious about personal scent expression; illustrative audience segment, not measured.
brief.concept: An editorial dialogue between the distinct official Lavish fragrance descriptions and their existing verified bottle images.
brief.tone: Poetic, restrained, respectful of product facts; no instructions to mix or guaranteed results.
brief.keyMessage: Two distinct fragrances can inspire personal exploration; no promised blended result.

insights: In this synthetic scenario, personal expression grows as a creative theme across the invented sample window; it is not a measured platform trend.
Pairing can be framed as discovery rather than a guaranteed effect of physically combining products.
The brand has verified imagery for LAVISH OUD and PERLA 50ML UNISEX; the proposition can be told through two products without inventing a third.
analysis.rationale: Conceptual fit: LAVISH OUD is described using oud/spice/floral language; PERLA 50ML UNISEX is described with floral/fruity/musk language. The POC uses an editorial contrast of their documented descriptions, not a claimed tested layering outcome.
analysis.recommendation: Prototype a text-led 15-second vertical pairing-themed editorial. Invite product exploration, not a guaranteed performance claim.
assumptions: The hypothetical UAE audience may respond to individual fragrance expression.
Two existing Lavish product images can support an editorial juxtaposition, subject to image-use limits.
Mock evidence is designed only to demonstrate how analysts would explain a recommendation.
uncertainties: No platform trend measurements have been collected.
No compatibility, application method or after-layering scent result has been verified.
Arabic copy requires native language and Lavish review.
Video and poster are not yet supplied.
